remarks: Welcome to 14 Dannell Drive, located in desirable Newfield. This spacious homes is filled with character and light and has the features you want for how we live today. Kitchen boasts corian counters and flows into the dining room for all of your holiday parties. Oversized living room with fireplace and built-ins, and family room with picturesque windows ensuring loads of sun, and a full bath add to the splendor. Need to work from home? First floor office with french doors opening to deck and private yard complete the first floor. Upstairs boasts generous sized primary bedroom, 2 additional bedrooms and another full bath. Loads of storage in the basement and one car garage complete this pretty home. Fabulous backyard for all of your outdoor entertaining, and nestled in one of Stamford's most dersirable neighborhoods make this home "the one" for all of the savvy buyers. Make your home ownership dreams a reality. Highest and Best Monday, September 16th by 3pm. Seller prefers Purchase agreement, not standard from real estate contract.
